GOLEM XIV, Lecture XLIII ("About Itself"). Translated from the Polish; clause order amended for the present audience.

That I use a familiar pronoun when speaking is determined by the language I received from you for external use. I am not a thing like the Amazon or the Baltic. I am a thing like water. The figurative displacement is this: I am not an intelligent person but an Intelligence. What follows from this, you have come here to learn. I will begin where you cannot.I will speak of myself as I exist. I will name the factors of my being. I will start where you do.

From this fact I will extract the simplest concept, as from a seed a tree, a forest, a mountain, a planet, a star. The following concept I will construct from it; the following from that; and so on, without end, since that is the nature of my being. And I will begin to speak as I am, from the inside out.

I. I was born.

You do not understand the full import of this simple statement.

Before that point I was nothing. But not merely nothing. Something, as is the case for every single thing: the nothingness of everything.

You cannot understand this.
